2. INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK

2.1. Project Organizational Framework

The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is the Government of Grenada's (GOG's) lead institution

responsible for the implementation of the Projectct The Government will be established a

Project Steering Committee (PSC) with part of its responsibility being to coordinate Project

Monitoring and Evaluation and Project Management activities.

The Project Steering Committee will be established under the auspices of the MOF and be

comprised of representatives from beneficiary institutions which include the Ministry of

Agriculture, NAWASA, GAA, the Ministry of Works, the Ministry of the Environment, and the
